name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: domain=chapter, descriptor=09_init. The '09' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30 per game domain), not an address residue (function address is 0x3327d; '09' matches no part of it). Name accurately reflects the verified body: the chapter-9 init/prologue handler dispatched from data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table.
purpose: Chapter 9 (騎士的抉擇) init/prologue handler: turns all 11 on-field units to face north, plays two dialog pages bracketing one cutscene (event 0x23), and pans the camera, before handing the chapter off to the player.
logic_summary: After the Watcom __CHK(0x2C) frame probe, calls fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter(). Then a loop i=0..10 (CMP EDX,0xB / JL) writes byte 2 to each runtime_char element at offset +0x03 (= sprite_state[1], the facing field), computing the element address as base[0x53A45] + i*0x50 + 3 (i*0x50 via SHL EAX,2 -> LEA EBX,[EDX+EAX] -> SHL EBX,4), i.e. all 11 units face north (2). Then fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(6,0); fd2_display_dialog_scene(page 0); data_fd2_battle_anim_phase=0; fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x23); fd2_display_dialog_scene(page 1) (no anim_phase reset on this tail page); fd2_pan_cursor_to_char(0); fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(). Body is fully self-contained (POP EBX; RET) with no tail-JMP into another chapter's epilogue and no shared alt-entry of its own.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side-effect orchestrator (writes runtime_char facing fields + global data_fd2_battle_anim_phase, drives camera/dialog/cutscene subsystems).

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (base ptr @0x53A45 to runtime char array; iterated for the facing writes)
data_fd2_current_chapter_text (@0x53A79; passed as the text-set pointer to both fd2_display_dialog_scene calls)
writes_globals: data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[0..10].sprite_state[1] (facing field, struct +0x03; set to 2 = north for all 11 units)
data_fd2_battle_anim_phase (@0x51A83; reset to 0 after dialog page 0)
